name: @intent-wallet/capabilities
description: Capability Registry — the deterministic 'what can this chain / provider-route actually do?' core. It ANSWERS capability questions (which chain supports staking / bridging / smart accounts, under what fee & finality mechanics, and which provider route-classes even exist) from VERSIONED DATA keyed on CAIP-2 ids. The Intent Engine + Route Optimizer CONSULT it so they decide on dynamic capabilities instead of hardcoded assumptions. It never quotes, never scores, never executes, never touches the network — live provider health stays in @intent-wallet/providers. Fail-closed: an unknown chain or capability is NOT supported. A new chain/provider is a new profile (data), not new code. Standalone, offline-testable.
